name: renhua
description: Renhua (人话): write Chinese posts, diaries, product copy and comment replies in a real person's voice and strip AI tells (emoji checklists, parallel triplets, slogan endings, stock closing questions), with a viral Xiaohongshu title library and humor patterns. Use when writing Chinese content for Xiaohongshu, X, WeChat Moments or a product page, or when the user says it sounds like AI and should sound human. Triggers: 太像 AI 了, 说人话, 去 AI 味, 用我的口吻, 写小红书, 写朋友圈, 产品介绍; 中国語の投稿をAIっぽくなく; 중국어 글 AI 티 안 나게; viết bài tiếng Trung tự nhiên; चीनी पोस्ट इंसानी लहजे में.
